propositions: The test `test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer` walks the entire corpus (884 units) in a single monolithic function, causing ~1768 serial pandoc spawns that measure 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding the 300s per-test timeout on contended macOS runners.

pytest-timeout with `--timeout-method=thread` calls `os._exit(1)` from a timer thread when the budget is exceeded, killing the xdist worker process outright without a traceback and reporting `node down: Not properly terminated` followed by a worker crash.

The fix replaces the monolithic loop with chunk-parametrized tests using a fixed `_EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK = 40` constant, reducing per-test cost to ~4.2s idle and bounding future growth structurally as the corpus expands.

A new coverage guard test `test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit` ensures no units are dropped by chunking and validates >= 100 units are covered, replacing the inline corpus size assertion.
